title: Brolucizumab in Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration – Indian Real-World Experience: The BRAILLE Study – Fifty-Two-Week Outcomes

license.statement: CC BY-NC 3.0 (article <license>: Dove Medical Press terms incorporating the Creative Commons Attribution - Non Commercial (unported, v3.0) License); private record

condition: Neovascular age-related macular degeneration (polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy excluded by ICGA), treatment-naive or recalcitrant to aflibercept/ranibizumab and switched; intravitreal brolucizumab with 4-weekly reviews and PRN retreatment; retrospective multicentre chart analysis (four Indian tertiary centres, 2020-2022) of the eyes with 52-week follow-up data

groups.description: Recalcitrant eyes switched from aflibercept or ranibizumab (fluid worsening or persistent despite repeated doses; baseline-defined subgroup)

series.notes: mean ± SD (see notes on the statistic); weeks 12, 24, 36 and 52 from the first brolucizumab injection (weeks x 7 / 30.4375 months); analysis restricted to eyes with 52-week data

series.baseline_label: Baseline at the switch to brolucizumab (Table 2, CST switch-therapy column)
series.notes: mean ± SD (see notes on the statistic); weeks 12, 24, 36 and 52 from the first brolucizumab injection (weeks x 7 / 30.4375 months); analysis restricted to eyes with 52-week data; the 36-week and 52-week cells of this column have identical text in the article (cited as published)

exclusions.reason: whole cohort tabulated with its baseline subgroups; the subgroups are extracted so that no eye is counted twice

exclusions.what: Table 2 P value rows (R5, R7, R9, R11)
Table 3 proportions with SRF, IRF and PED
12 eyes lost to follow-up before week 52
exclusions.reason: not in the analysed set (not tabulated)

notes: Visual acuity, fluid status, injection numbers and adverse events are reported (not extracted).
Post-baseline events (intraocular inflammation in three eyes; vitrectomy for vitreous haemorrhage in two eyes) are not reported as removing or replacing values.

Ambiguity resolved: Table 2 labels only BCVA as median [IQR]; the Methods report normally distributed continuous variables as mean±SD and non-normal ones as median (IQR), the CST cells use the ± notation, and the Results describe 'mean CST' for the cohort and subgroups, so the CST statistic is taken as mean ± SD.
Ambiguity resolved: restricting the analysis to eyes with 52-week data is attrition, not an outcome-defined selection, so the series are kept with a note.
Ambiguity resolved: the SD-OCT device is not named, so device is unstated.
